+import math
+from typing import Literal
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

+class RateLimit(BaseModel):

+    per_seconds: float = Field(gt=0)

+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_per_seconds_finite(cls, v: float) -> float:
+        if not math.isfinite(v):
+            raise ValueError("per_seconds must be finite")
+        return v
+
+
+class Quota(BaseModel):
+    max_calls: int = Field(gt=0)
+
+
+class LimitPolicy(BaseModel):
+    rate_limit: RateLimit | None = None
+    quota: Quota | None = None
+    scope: Literal["server", "session"] = "server"
+
+
+class LimitDecision(BaseModel):
+    allowed: bool
+    retry_after: float | None = None
+    remaining: int | None = None
+    reason: Literal["rate_limit", "quota"] | None = None
+
+
+def evaluate(
+    policy: LimitPolicy,
+    call_times: list[float],
+    now: float,
+) -> LimitDecision:
+    if not math.isfinite(now) or now < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid now: {now}")
+
+    for t in call_times:
+        if not math.isfinite(t):
+            raise ValueError(f"Non-finite timestamp in call_times: {t}")
+        if t > now:
+            raise ValueError(f"Timestamp in future relative to now: {t} > {now}")
+
+    quota_applies = policy.quota is not None
+    rate_applies = policy.rate_limit is not None
+
+    if not quota_applies and not rate_applies:
+        return LimitDecision(allowed=True, retry_after=None, remaining=None, reason=None)
+
+    quota_denies = False
+    quota_remaining = None
+    if quota_applies:
+        assert policy.quota is not None
+        used = len(call_times)
+        if used >= policy.quota.max_calls:
+            quota_denies = True
+            quota_remaining = 0
+        else:
+            quota_remaining = policy.quota.max_calls - used - 1
+
+    rate_denies = False
+    rate_remaining = None
+    retry_after = None
+    if rate_applies:
+        assert policy.rate_limit is not None
+        per_seconds = policy.rate_limit.per_seconds

+        in_window = len(in_window_times)

+            rate_denies = True
+            rate_remaining = 0
+            sorted_in_window = sorted(in_window_times)
+            blocking_idx = in_window - max_calls
+            blocking_t = sorted_in_window[blocking_idx]
+            retry_after = blocking_t + per_seconds - now
+        else:
+            rate_remaining = max_calls - in_window - 1
+

+            remaining=0,

+    elif quota_remaining is not None:
+        remaining = quota_remaining
+    else:

+

+
+        if quota_denies:
+            return LimitDecision(allowed=False, retry_after=None, remaining=0, reason="quota")
+
+        if rate_denies:
+            return LimitDecision(

+        else:
+            remaining = rate_remaining
+
+        return LimitDecision(
+            allowed=True,
+            retry_after=None,
+            remaining=remaining,
+            reason=None,

+        self._validate_now(now)

+"""Limit policy model and pure decision logic."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator
+
+
+class RateLimit(BaseModel):
+    max_calls: int = Field(gt=0)
+    per_seconds: float = Field(gt=0)
+
+    @field_validator("per_seconds")
+    @classmethod
+    def _finite_per_seconds(cls, v: float) -> float:
+        if not math.isfinite(v):
+            raise ValueError("per_seconds must be finite")
+        return v
+
+
+class Quota(BaseModel):
+    max_calls: int = Field(gt=0)
+
+
+class LimitPolicy(BaseModel):
+    rate_limit: RateLimit | None = None
+    quota: Quota | None = None
+    scope: Literal["server", "session"] = "server"
+
+
+class LimitDecision(BaseModel):
+    allowed: bool
+    retry_after: float | None = None
+    remaining: int | None = None
+    reason: Literal["rate_limit", "quota"] | None = None
+
+
+def _validate_time_args(call_times: list[float], now: float) -> None:
+    if not math.isfinite(now):
+        raise ValueError("now must be finite")
+    if now < 0:
+        raise ValueError("now must be >= 0")
+    for t in call_times:
+        if not math.isfinite(t):
+            raise ValueError("call_times entries must be finite")
+        if t > now:
+            raise ValueError("call_times entries must not be after now")
+
+
+def evaluate(policy: LimitPolicy, call_times: list[float], now: float) -> LimitDecision:
+    _validate_time_args(call_times, now)
+
+    rate = policy.rate_limit
+    quota = policy.quota
+
+    if rate is not None:
+        per = rate.per_seconds
+        in_window_list = [t for t in call_times if now - t < per]
+        in_window = len(in_window_list)
+    else:
+        in_window_list = []
+        in_window = 0
+
+    used = len(call_times)
+
+    rate_denies = rate is not None and in_window >= rate.max_calls
+    quota_denies = quota is not None and used >= quota.max_calls
+
+    if quota_denies:
+        return LimitDecision(allowed=False, retry_after=None, remaining=0, reason="quota")
+
+    if rate_denies:
+        assert rate is not None
+        sorted_window = sorted(in_window_list)
+        idx = in_window - rate.max_calls
+        blocking = sorted_window[idx]
+        retry_after = blocking + rate.per_seconds - now
+        return LimitDecision(
+            allowed=False, retry_after=retry_after, remaining=0, reason="rate_limit"
+        )
+
+    # allowed
+    if rate is None and quota is None:
+        remaining = None
+    elif rate is not None and quota is not None:
+        remaining = min(rate.max_calls - in_window - 1, quota.max_calls - used - 1)
+    elif rate is not None:
+        remaining = rate.max_calls - in_window - 1
+    else:
+        assert quota is not None
+        remaining = quota.max_calls - used - 1
+    return LimitDecision(allowed=True, retry_after=None, remaining=remaining, reason=None)
+
+
+class LimitState:
+    def __init__(self, policy: LimitPolicy) -> None:
+        self.policy: LimitPolicy = policy
+        self._total: int = 0
+        self._window: list[float] = []
+        self._last: float | None = None
+
+    def _validate_now(self, now: float) -> None:
+        if not math.isfinite(now):
+            raise ValueError("now must be finite")
+        if now < 0:
+            raise ValueError("now must be >= 0")
+        if self._last is not None and now < self._last:
+            raise ValueError("time must not go backwards")
+
+    def check(self, now: float) -> LimitDecision:
+        self._validate_now(now)
+        rate = self.policy.rate_limit
+        quota = self.policy.quota
+
+        if rate is not None:
+            per = rate.per_seconds
+            in_window_list = [t for t in self._window if now - t < per]
+            in_window = len(in_window_list)
+        else:
+            in_window_list = []
+            in_window = 0
+
+        used = self._total
+
+        rate_denies = rate is not None and in_window >= rate.max_calls
+        quota_denies = quota is not None and used >= quota.max_calls
+
+        if quota_denies:
+            return LimitDecision(allowed=False, retry_after=None, remaining=0, reason="quota")
+
+        if rate_denies:
+            assert rate is not None
+            sorted_window = sorted(in_window_list)
+            idx = in_window - rate.max_calls
+            blocking = sorted_window[idx]
+            retry_after = blocking + rate.per_seconds - now
+            return LimitDecision(
+                allowed=False, retry_after=retry_after, remaining=0, reason="rate_limit"
+            )
+
+        if rate is None and quota is None:
+            remaining = None
+        elif rate is not None and quota is not None:
+            remaining = min(rate.max_calls - in_window - 1, quota.max_calls - used - 1)
+        elif rate is not None:
+            remaining = rate.max_calls - in_window - 1
+        else:
+            assert quota is not None
+            remaining = quota.max_calls - used - 1
+        return LimitDecision(allowed=True, retry_after=None, remaining=remaining, reason=None)
+
+    def record(self, now: float) -> None:
+        self._validate_now(now)
+        self._last = now
+        self._total += 1
+        if self.policy.rate_limit is not None:
+            per = self.policy.rate_limit.per_seconds
+            self._window.append(now)
+            # Drop timestamps outside the window relative to recorded now.
+            self._window = [t for t in self._window if now - t < per]
+        # Without a rate limit no timestamps are kept.
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        self._total = 0
+        self._window = []
+        self._last = None

+                rate_remaining = max_calls - in_window - 1
+
+        quota_allowed = True
+        quota_remaining: int | None = None
+        if policy.quota is not None:
+            used = self._quota_count
+            if used >= policy.quota.max_calls:
+                quota_allowed = False
+            else:
+                quota_remaining = policy.quota.max_calls - used - 1
+
+        if not quota_allowed:
+            return LimitDecision(allowed=False, retry_after=None, remaining=0, reason="quota")
+
+        if not rate_allowed:
+            return LimitDecision(allowed=False, retry_after=retry_after, remaining=0, reason="rate_limit")
+
+        if rate_remaining is not None and quota_remaining is not None:
+            remaining = min(rate_remaining, quota_remaining)
+        elif rate_remaining is not None:
+            remaining = rate_remaining
+        else:
+            remaining = quota_remaining
+
+        return LimitDecision(allowed=True, retry_after=None, remaining=remaining, reason=None)
+
+    def record(self, now: float) -> None:
+        self._validate_now(now)
+        self._last_recorded = now
+        self._quota_count += 1
+        if self.policy.rate_limit is not None:
+            per_sec = self.policy.rate_limit.per_seconds
+            self._rate_timestamps.append(now)
+            self._rate_timestamps = [t for t in self._rate_timestamps if now - t < per_sec]
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        self._rate_timestamps.clear()
+        self._quota_count = 0
+        self._last_recorded = None
